name: Long-term (base-collection) storage of dried orthodox crop seed at -18 ± 3 °C and 15 ± 3% RH in sealed airtight containers (FAO Genebank Standard 4.2.3)
plain_name: Keep a seed bank's master copies of crop seeds in a minus-18 freezer for decades
description: Genebanks conserve the most-original samples and safety duplicates of orthodox crop seed (maize, wheat, rice, etc.) after drying to equilibrium at 5-20 °C and 10-25% RH, sealing in airtight containers and storing at -18 ± 3 °C. The same -18 °C regime is used at the Svalbard Global Seed Vault (artificial cooling keeps a constant -18 C) and for USDA ARS original (base) seed collections.
keywords: Keep a seed bank's master copies of crop seeds in a minus-18 freezer for decades

sources.citation: FAO (2014). Genebank Standards for Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture. Rome, FAO (I3704E)
Svalbard Global Seed Vault: The facility (seedvault.no)
USDA ARS North Central Regional Plant Introduction Station (Ames, Iowa): Storage Conditions

reported_equipment: single stage standard deep freezer compressor (FAO context for -18 °C)
Svalbard Global Seed Vault artificial cooling system
USDA ARS NCRPIS original seed collection storage at -18°C

requirements.rationale: Base collections are stored at a set point of -18 °C (255.15 K).
The standard asks for storage within ±3 °C of the set temperature; optional because it is phrased as best effort with limited excursions allowed.
